selection.summary: PR #1971 adds `gh repo view .` with local/remote readme fallback and provenance display. Base evidence covers the repo view command (view.go: command setup, repo resolution, openURL/web path, readme fetch at ~line 112 via RepositoryReadme(opts.Branch), rendering flow), http.go (RepositoryReadme fetching remote repos/%s/readme with base64 decode, NotFoundError), ghrepo.FromFullName URL/nwo resolution handling "." args, and view_test.go mocks that only exercise remote readme endpoints with no local-file fallback or provenance indication currently present.
